meaning: From necessary-existence positivity alone, a God-like individual has 1970 NecessaryExistence. The already proved EmptyPropertyIsEssence makes the empty property one of its essences, so any accessible successor would have an existing individual with False. A possibility witness supplies an edge into the God-like world; symmetry supplies its outgoing reverse edge, giving contradiction. Only Ax3 and symmetry are retained: Ax2a, Ax2b/A4, Ax4, reflexivity and excluded middle are not premises. This proves the 1970 actualist Th3 antecedent is impossible even though its smaller axiom bundle is satisfiable; it does not prove theism false, Scott inconsistent, or the partial axioms inconsistent.
